name: Cunning (3rd Party – Flaming Crab Games)
body:
You have a knack for learning.

Benefit: You gain 3 skill ranks. For every Hit Die you possess beyond 3, you gain an additional 1 skill rank. If you have more than 3 Hit Dice, you gain 1 skill rank whenever you gain a Hit Die (such as when you gain a level).

Special: A rogue may select this feat as a rogue talent.
